theme: An open day before tomorrow's house move.

needsAttention.detail: Tomorrow is the House 1 → House 2 changeover. Pack the portable larder bin today so the first migration is a test run while there's still time to fix what doesn't work.

needsAttention.title: Two Croatia bookings still open
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 19 Cavtat hotel night and the Sept 20–22 St. Pete landing gap are still unbooked, with a hard wall of your Sept 8 departure — charter connectivity is poor, so these have to be set from dry land.
